fields.System.Title: CNT-202 — Blind count entry
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want counters never to see the expected quantity, so that
they count what is there instead of confirming what the system thinks.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a count task response, then the expected quantity **does not appear anywhere in
  • the payload** — not in a hidden field, not in a nested object, not in metadata.
  • - Given the count client, then it cannot obtain the expected quantity through any other
  • endpoint while the count is open.
  • - Given a counter, then they scan the location and enter a quantity per product found.
  • - Given an unexpected product found in the location, then it can be recorded.
  • - Given a submitted count, then it cannot be edited after submission — a correction is a
  • recount.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | counting |
| Tables | count_task, count_result |
| Risks | Expected quantity visible makes counts meaningless ([doc 09 §6.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration (assert full payload contains no expected quantity) |
